EXECUTIVE SUMMARY;/Due to thefactthat the Cheyenne Regional Airport Board is
a joint powers board comprised of appointees from both the City of Cheyenne andthe
Countyof Laramie, the U.S.Department of Transportation requires that both of the
governing bodies, as well as the Airport Board, approve Federal grantsfor Airport
improvements and/ormarketing orrevenue guarantee purposes.Assuch, attachedfor
yourreview and consideration for approval during the nextmeeting of the City Council
is a grant from the U.s.Dept.of Transportation for a Small Community Air Service
Development Grant in the amount of$200,000.
By definition, the SCA SDP is a grant program designed to help small communities
address air service and airfare issues, is managed by the Associate Director, Small
Community Air Service Development, underthe Officeof Aviation Analysis.SCASDP's
eligibility criteria are broader and provide a grant applicant the opportunity to self-
identify its air service deficiencies and propose an appropriate solution.SCASDP can
involve, among others, revenue guarantees, financial assistance for marketing
programs, start-up costs and studies.
FISCAL IMPACT&FUNDING SOURCES FOR RECOMMENDED ACTION: None.
RECOMMENDED OPTIONS: Approve Grant Contract aS presented.
1:
BACKGROUND AND ISSUE ANALYSIS:
As City Council is aware, the Airport has struggled thepast two years to retain reliable
and increased air service for the region.Unfortunately, due to the federal legislation
passed in2012, requiring airlines to hire pilots with 1,500 hours of flight time, airline
service in Cheyenne, as well as the State, continues to see a significant decline in
passenger service.
In order to provide the region withmore options for air travel, the Cheyenne Regional
Airport believes by entering into a Small Community Air Service Development
Agreement that it will allow additional funds to be expended to attract and retain
additional air carrier service for the region and Cheyenne.
Thankyou foryour attentionto this matter.If you should have any questions, please
contactmeat634-7071.
